## Free audit workflow

1. Read project instructions and existing checklists.
2. Inspect **read-only** first: live pages, Search Console (if available), build and relevant tests.
3. Audit crawl/indexing, metadata, canonical, hreflang where needed, content clarity, business consistency, links and performance.
4. Include AI-search readability only as an evidence-based extension of helpful SEO, not a promise of recommendation or citations.
5. Label findings OBSERVED / INFERRED / NEEDS LIVE CHECK / NOT TESTED. Record dated evidence and acceptance criteria.
6. Prioritize true customer enquiries. Propose a narrow, reviewable PR; merge/deploy only with client approval.
7. Re-test live URLs and compare the same length of reporting periods; do not confuse impressions, key events and real leads.

## Using the two shared skills

Copy `.agents/skills/seo-geo-audit/SKILL.md` and `.agents/skills/local-seo-geo/SKILL.md` from `gyanart/gyanart` into this new project's repo.
